summary: Interpretation of S.143A NI Act; whether interim compensation provision (20% of cheque amount) is mandatory or directory; 'may' interpreted contextually, not mechanically; S.143A read with objects to prevent frivolous litigation & ensure swift recovery; compensation order upheld in summons cases upon plea recording; quantum determination requires factual analysis; conviction under S.138 NI Act upheld; standard: commercial practicality over strict textualism; appellate courts must balance pre-trial burden.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; interim compensation under S.143A upheld as valid; High Court judgment affirmed; 20% interim payment order sustained pending trial conclusion.
